tools.name: query_minute_bars
tools.description: Full trading day of intraday bars for one US stock (interval 3-240 min, default 3m). Returns pct_open/pct_high/pct_low/pct_close as fractional change from that day's open, plus volume and transactions. Absolute price = day_open * (1 + pct); get day_open from query_daily. $0.025 USDC.

tools.name: list_tickers
tools.description: List all tickers that traded on a given date. $0.005 USDC.

tools.name: query_range
tools.description: Multi-day intraday bars for one ticker (interval 3-240 min, default 3m). Fractional change from each day's own open — percentages reset daily, not cumulative. $0.01/day, no day limit.

tools.name: query_batch
tools.description: Multiple tickers for one date. Each ticker's bars are fractional change from its own daily open. $0.02/ticker, no limit.

tools.name: scan_market
tools.description: Scan all US stocks on a date for custom criteria (gaps, volume, change). Returns pct_change, range_pct, pct_gap, true_range_pct, volume and volume_ratio per match — criteria in percent (5 = 5%), outputs fractional (0.05 = 5%). $0.10 USDC.

tools.name: query_daily
tools.description: Daily OHLCV bars plus VWAP, range_pct and true_range_pct for one ticker over a date range. range_pct = (high - low) / open is a ready-made volatility read; true_range_pct also captures the overnight gap. Carries the absolute price levels — pair with the intraday tools to reconstruct prices. $0.001/y

tools.name: get_brief
tools.description: Full research brief: price, fundamentals, insiders, splits for one ticker. $0.25 USDC.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Company profile: name, CIK, industry, exchange, fiscal year. $0.005 USDC.

tools.name: get_fundamentals
tools.description: Quarterly fundamentals from SEC EDGAR (revenue, EPS, margins, etc). $0.02 USDC.

tools.name: get_insiders
tools.description: Insider transactions (Form 4) from SEC EDGAR. $0.02 USDC.

tools.name: get_filings
tools.description: SEC filing index (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, proxies) for a ticker. $0.01 USDC; add sections=[risk_factors, mdna] to extract full section text from the latest 10-K/10-Q for $0.05.

tools.name: get_bars
tools.description: Resampled intraday bars at custom timeframes (3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 30, 60, 240 min) for one ticker. Fractional change from the daily open regardless of interval, plus volume and transactions. $0.015 USDC per day.

tools.name: get_sample
tools.description: FREE, no payment: real intraday OHLCV bars for AAPL on 2024-01-02, identical in shape to a paid query. Call this first to verify data quality before spending. Takes no arguments — fixed ticker and date.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Pricing and data coverage information. Free.
